# Jens Kjeldsen

Jens Kjeldsen is a Ledende overlæge (chief physician), professor, and Ph.D. holder based at Region Syddanmark who serves as a steering committee member of [[danibd|DANIBD]], Denmark's national database for inflammatory bowel disease [^src1][^src2]. He represents Region Syddanmark's medical expertise within the database's governance structure, which coordinates care for inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) patients across all five Danish regions [^src1].

Kjeldsen's participation in DANIBD's steering committee spans at least 2023–2024, a period during which the database documented the treatment of 33,381 IBD patients and tracked the administration of biologic therapies to 10,523 patients across Danish hospital systems [^src1]. His role reflects the steering committee's broader composition: medical, surgical, and nursing representatives from all Danish regions, supplemented by patient representatives and data management support from RKKP, the Danish clinical quality program registry [^src1].
